facts.summary: Missed primary endpoint in ITT; per-protocol significant · Phase 2/3 · belapectin in MASH cirrhosis portal hypertension · not yet approved
facts.indication: MASH cirrhosis with portal hypertension (prevention of esophageal varices)

evidence.summary: While there was a favorable trend for incidence of varices in the primary end point intent-to-treat population, belapectin did not achieve statistical significance
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the composite endpoint did not reach statistical significance
evidence.safety: Belapectin was overall well tolerated with no safety signals; incidence of adverse events and serious adverse events were comparable across the three cohorts
